redeploy.title: Move to another server
redeploy.body: Move this project onto a new server. This server is left as it is.
redeploy.needsCode: The new server must already run the project's code with the same environment: its virtual environment, django-dbs and the same settings.
redeploy.how: When this server answers, a fresh backup of it is taken now and restored. The new server's .env file and data are recorded first; then the .env file is pushed, the migrations run, the backup is restored and the new server is checked.
redeploy.backup: Backup to restore if this server does not answer
redeploy.backupHint: The newest is chosen. When this server answers, a fresh backup is restored instead.
redeploy.noBackup: None: stop if this server does not answer
redeploy.flush: Replace the data on the new server instead of merging
redeploy.passwordHint: Needed to move for real. A rehearsal needs no password.

progress.title: Moving
progress.rehearsed: The rehearsal finished. Nothing was changed on either server.
progress.chosenBackup: This server did not answer, so the chosen backup was restored.
progress.sourceSilent: This server did not answer. A move now would restore the chosen backup instead of a fresh one.

steps.safety_backup: Back up the new server's data

revert.title: Revert the new server
revert.body: Push the new server's recorded .env file back and restore the backup of its data taken before the move, replacing what the move left there.
revert.passwordHint: Needed to revert for real. A rehearsal needs no password.
revert.done: The new server is back as it was before the move.
revert.rehearsed: The revert rehearsal finished. Nothing was changed.

steps.restore: Restore the data from before the move

errors.targetRequired: Choose the server to move to.

errors.passphrase_missing: The backup passphrase of this server is not saved here.
errors.confirm_name_mismatch: Type the new server's name exactly as shown.
errors.same_server: Choose a server other than this one.
errors.target_not_ready: django-dbs is not installed on the new server, or the project is not ready there.
errors.source_unreachable: This server did not answer and no backup of it was chosen.
errors.no_backup_to_rehearse: There is no backup of this server here for the rehearsal to restore. Take one first.
errors.move_not_revertable: Only a move that stopped after it changed the new server can be reverted.
